messages:
Lila (FinOps): Quick flag  bulk of last night's batch GPU credits (~$31k) show under project 'shared-batch' instead of team projects. billing-bot: Alert: Billing drift detected for BA-12345  project concentration 'shared-batch' exceeded baseline. Omar (Billing Ops): Can someone attach the raw export rows and sample ledger ids? Need to know if these are credits or normal usage. Rae (Infra): Uploaded a small extract: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/exports/BA-12345?file=batch-2026-03-20.csv. Many rows have label_team_owner = "" and label_batch_fallback = "shared-batch". Nina (ML Platform): We rolled out a batch-scheduling tweak that sets batch_fallback for unlabelled pods so nightly jobs don't pollute team buckets. Looks like it matched too eagerly when pod metadata delayed. Hector (CostOps): That explains the spike. Impact on customer budgets? Lila (FinOps): Some internal team budgets under-reported spend; potential revenue recognition noise. Recommend manual reallocation up to $35k while we fix the rule. Omar (Billing Ops): I can run reallocation if someone provides ledger_id -> suggested_owner mapping and a short justification memo. Nina (ML Platform): I'll change fallback to 'unassigned-batch' and add a guard so fallback doesn't apply unless a pod annotation explicitly opts in. Rae (Infra): Running quick query to pull affected ledger ids and timestamps now (short SQL):

SELECT usage_start_time, project_id, ledger_id, label_team_owner, label_batch_fallback, cost
FROM `billing_export.gcp_costs`
WHERE invoice_month='2026-03' AND DATE(usage_start_time)='2026-03-20'
  AND (label_team_owner IS NULL OR label_team_owner='')
  AND label_batch_fallback='shared-batch';

Rae (Infra): I'll upload mapping CSV to Drive when done. Omar (Billing Ops): Use internal memo template: - invoice_ref: 2026-03-20-BA-12345 - affected_ledger_ids: [] - proposed_owner: team_name - amount: numeric - reason: fallback label applied when pod metadata lagged Nina (ML Platform): PR queued: https://git.redwood/repo/ml/patches/PR-812  changes fallback + adds opt-in annotation. Hector (CostOps): Also request an alert rule: notify if >$2k lands in 'shared-batch' in 3h window. Lila (FinOps): Approving one-off realloc up to $35k pending mapping & QA. billing-bot: Action logged: ticket BILL-4705 created, assigned Omar, Rae, Nina, Hector; severity P2. Omar (Billing Ops): I'll run reallocation once mapping uploaded and post journal entry ids here. Lila (FinOps): thanks team. Close on my side when journal refs posted. :thumbsup:
